title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Unify finance and operations system administrator user and role management in Power Platform admin center
description: Administrators can now manage system administrator users and security roles for both finance and operations apps and Dataverse from a single, unified experience in Power Platform admin center. Instead of switching between the finance and operations Users and Security configuration pages and the Dataverse user and role pages, admins can add and enable users, assign and remove roles, and review user access across both from one place. This generally available release follows the public preview and gives admins consistent, centralized identity and access administration for finance and operations environments.
